title: The Born Rule as the Unique Refinement-Stable Induced Weight on Robust Record Sectors
summary: This paper proves a conditional structural uniqueness theorem for induced weight on robust record sectors within an admissible Hilbert record layer. Its theorem target and additive carrier differ from those of the standard Born-rule routes: additivity is not placed on the full projector lattice, but on disjoint admissible continuation bundles through an extensive bundle valuation, from which the sector-level additive law is inherited under admissible refinement.
